item: L2-1 base image (git only): ubuntu:24.04 + git
why: The check must run in an image with nothing but git. The image digest and git version are not fixed yet; util-linux `script` (bsdutils, an essential package) and the built-in C.UTF-8 locale are assumed to be present and must be confirmed (calibration.md step 1).

candidates.license: Ubuntu image: various free licenses; git: GPL-2.0
candidates.size: about 30 MB compressed image + about 20 MB for git and its dependencies
candidates.pin: Record the ubuntu:24.04 image digest (sha256) and `git --version` / `dpkg -s git | grep Version` at freeze; build the image once and reuse the digest for both groups
